name: 74116 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74116 (Tulsa) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74116 (Tulsa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
